Nowadays, volunteer is very popular in university. From the chart, we can see some students do not like volunteer. 35% students never join, most students only join one or two time. Few students join many times.

Why this happen? I think one reason is students is busy with their homework, another reason is volunteer is boring.

In conclude, volunteer have many advantage. It can make us happy and learn knowledge. University should let students to do more volunteer. Student also should do it.
